user_story: As a new user, I want to register with my name, email, and password so that I can create an account.

positive.title: Successful Registration with Valid Inputs
steps: Enter a valid name in the 'Name' field.
Enter a valid email in the 'Email' field.
Enter a valid password in the 'Password' field.
positive.expected_result: User successfully creates an account and is directed to the welcome page.

negative.title: Registration Fails with Invalid Email
steps: Enter a valid name in the 'Name' field.
Enter an invalid email format in the 'Email' field.
Enter a valid password in the 'Password' field.
negative.expected_result: User sees an error message indicating the email format is invalid.

edge.title: Registration with Maximum Length Inputs
steps: Enter the maximum allowed characters in the 'Name' field.
Enter the maximum allowed characters in the 'Email' field.
Enter the maximum allowed characters in the 'Password' field.
edge.expected_result: User successfully creates an account and is directed to the welcome page.
